item.title: Upgrade or isolate: Idunno AntiCsrf: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
item.description:
Idunno AntiCsrf: RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · end of life

First step: This version of Idunno AntiCsrf may be end of life and gets no more fixes. Move to a supported version, or cut it off from the internet until you can.

Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

Critical · Unsupported · CVE-2026-131914
